steps.en: Notices that already had the first letter are picked for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Notice yang sudah dikirimi surat pertama dipilih untuk pengingat elektronik
steps.why_en: The scheduled run for electronic reminders is switched off in every environment.
steps.why_id: Proses terjadwal untuk pengingat elektronik dimatikan di setiap environment.

steps.en: The latest mobile number and email are checked and saved
steps.id: Nomor mobile dan email terbaru dicek dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The latest-contact lookup is switched off by a setting, so stored contact details are used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian kontak terbaru dimatikan oleh setelan, jadi kontak yang tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Notices with no usable contact details are skipped
steps.id: Notice tanpa kontak yang bisa dipakai dilewati

steps.en: Owners who opted out or hold a passport are left out
steps.id: Owner yang opt-out atau ber-passport tidak diikutkan
